gh pr create --base main --head fix/issue-7-refresh-loop --title "Fix infinite recursion in refresh() when session expires" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes #7.

## Problem
`refresh()` in `src/auth.js` called itself with the same expired session, so it never returned and the page froze once the cookie expired.

## Change
- When the session is expired, `refresh()` now returns `fetchSession()` instead of recursing.
- `refresh()` is now `async`, since fetching a new session is asynchronous. Callers must `await` it.

## Note for review
`fetchSession` is not defined or imported anywhere in this repo (the only file is `src/auth.js`). The change calls it as the issue describes. If it lives in another module, it needs an import before this path works; without one, an expired session will throw a `ReferenceError` instead of hanging.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1
